messages:
alex: seeing intermittent DNS timeouts between gpu-pool pods and model-api. ~5-10% of requests hit resolve latency >500ms or SERVFAIL. Started around 02:14 UTC after node kernel update + a burst of pod scale-ups.
sre-bot: Alert: CoreDNS error rate spike in cluster-a (ns=system) 02:15 - 02:18 UTC
maria: can you paste `dig +time=2 @127.0.0.1 model-api.service` from an affected node?
alex: ```
dig +time=2 @127.0.0.1 model-api.service
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 12345
;model-api.service.    IN  A
;; Query time: 512 msec
```
jin: CoreDNS metrics show `node_cache` evictions spike and `failed_lookups_total` climbing. conntrack entries for ephemeral ports also skyrocketed during the scale-up.
sam: we rolled RDMA firmware last night on gpu nodes. there are known MTU regressions in that image. could be UDP fragmentation on east-west path — any `ip -s link` outputs show `dropped` or tx errors?
alex: ```
ip -s -s link show rdma0
3: rdma0: mtu 9000 qlen 1000
    RX: bytes 1.2G packets 12.3k errors 0 dropped 240 overruns 0
    TX: bytes 900M packets 9.8k errors 12 dropped 0 overruns 0
```
maria: 240 RX drops + `udp truncated` in node-local-dns logs looks like fragmentation/clamp issues.
jin: also noticed kube-proxy conntrack table approaching limits -> packets dropped to node-local-dns which causes retries and long tail for resolves. the timing matches the pod warmup fanout.
ops-lead: mitigation idea: enable node-local-dns TCP fallback and test iptables MTU clamp to 1450 on a canary set. also reduce upstream UDP timeout so we fail faster to TCP.
alex: trying TCP fallback now: `dig +tcp @127.0.0.1 model-api.service` returns A in ~60ms. i'll run a 10m test and report back.
alex: update: after enabling TCP fallback + MTU clamp on a canary subset, DNS error rate dropped from ~6% to ~0.5%. rolling to remaining nodes now.
sam: follow-up: we'll open an infra change to rollback the RDMA firmware to the previous stable build and schedule a proper canary in the next maintenance window. also adding recommended conntrack tuning to the ops runbook.
maria: adding monitoring changes: alert if node-local-dns queue depth > 50 or conntrack usage > 80% per node. capture tcpdump on SERVFAIL events for forensics.
jin: captured tcpdump: `kubectl exec node-local-dns -- tcpdump -n -w - udp port 53` showed many fragmented DNS UDP packets crossing east-west link; fragments reassembled intermittently.
alex: :thumbsup: thanks all — proceeding with rollout + postmortem. tagging @sam for the firmware rollback plan.
